name: deadline-departure-board
description: Solari-style split-flap countdown board for personal deadlines. Static HTML/CSS/JS, no build tool, no dependencies.

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync('dist');fs.copyFileSync('index.html','dist/index.html');fs.cpSync('css','dist/css',{recursive:true});fs.cpSync('js','dist/js',{recursive:true});console.log('Static site copied to dist/ — nothing to compile.')"
